partner_result_applied.theorem_used: QFORM-HEAVY-ROW-PROJECTED-RANK2-RIESZ-v1 plus disjoint normalized innovation-bank square smoother Eq. (5.2)
partner_result_applied.actual_application: For Q_m=X0^2+<X,u1>^2-<X,u2>^2 choose S=diag(1,-1), physical leverage ell=1, and disjoint normalized square bank <X,u1>; then ||p_Qm||_infinity <= 2^(3/4) C_ind = 27.8162566595... uniformly in m.

mathematical_change.statement: The universal bound E_Z ||rho_{E|Z}||_infinity^(2/3)<=C is false even for product unit cubes and E equal to the spectral range of a rank-three target form with eigenvalues {1,1,-1}.
mathematical_change.interpretation: Full-complement conditioning destroys the product aggregation needed for the curved quadratic pushforward; the surrogate diverges while the actual quadratic density stays uniformly bounded by the partner theorem.

unresolved_implication: Prove a product-preserving grouped-coordinate reduction or overlap-safe square smoother that extracts/pays enough original-coordinate innovation before conditioning while retaining arbitrary additional spectral components.
next_step: Attack overlapping innovation directly by retaining one physical coordinate in a rank-three frame and testing whether wedge/Plucker mass yields a triangular conditional innovation without assuming post-rotation independence.
